name: Myrtle Beach KOA Resort
note: KOA Resort at 613 5th Avenue South, Myrtle Beach; full-hookup and water/electric RV sites, pull-throughs. RV sites $68.94-232.02 a night before tax for a mid-May 2027 weeknight on KOA's booking form. RV Life 4*, $$$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: KOA booking form (koa.com/campgrounds/myrtle-beach/reserve/) quoted 2027-05-18, 1 night, 23-ft motorhome: RV site types $68.94-232.02 before tax (read 2026-10-19); RV Life 4* over 212 reviews, 540 sites; within 40 km of a gateway (Myrtle Beach (1 km), gateways.py), so the price gate is lifted
wf: KOA's booking form names only an 'OWNERS SITE - Waterfront' type (not for rent); re-audited: satellite (Esri, sat.py) read 2026-10-19: site loops under tall pines a few blocks off the beach; Withers Swash, a narrow tidal creek, crosses the park's east side under tree cover and no rentable pad is shown on an open bank; not waterfront
